dct_description_sm: This dataset contains spatial measurements of surface water nitrous oxide (N2O) and methane (CH4) concentrations around Vancouver Island, BC during summer 2024. This data was collected using an automated, high-frequency measurement system. The system consisted of a gas extraction module connected to an off-axis integrated cavity output spectrometer (OA-ICOS) gas analyzer. We conducted the spatial survey along the island's east and west coasts.
dct_subject_sm: Off-axis integrated cavity output spectroscopy (OA-ICOS) gas analyzer
dct_title_s: Spatial continuous measurements of surface water N2O and CH4 around Vancouver Island, British Columbia
